#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate COVID-19 Emergency Response Process Flow poster (A1 portrait)."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 3508, 4961

WHO_BLUE = (0, 114, 188)
WHO_BLUE_DARK = (0, 82, 136)
WHO_BLUE_LIGHT = (230, 243, 250)
WHO_BLUE_MED = (179, 215, 240)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
DARK_TEXT = (33, 37, 41)
GRAY_TEXT = (80, 88, 96)
ACCENT_TEAL = (0, 168, 168)
ACCENT_AMBER = (235, 164, 30)
PHASE_COLORS = [
    (0, 114, 188),
    (0, 148, 180),
    (0, 168, 168),
    (235, 164, 30),
    (76, 175, 80),
]

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(r, (x1 - x0) // 2, (y1 - y0) // 2)
    if r < 1:
        if fill:
            draw.rectangle(xy, fill=fill)
        return
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y1, x1 - r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0 + r, x0, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)


def arrow_down(draw, x, y0, y1, color):
    draw.line([(x, y0), (x, y1)], fill=color, width=6)
    s = 20
    draw.polygon([(x, y1 + s), (x - s, y1 - 2), (x + s, y1 - 2)], fill=color)


def circle_num(draw, cx, cy, r, n, bg):
    draw.ellipse([cx - r - 5, cy - r - 5, cx + r + 5, cy + r + 5], fill=bg)
    f = font(int(r * 1.05), bold=True)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), str(n), font=f)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    draw.text((cx - tw // 2, cy - th // 2 - 4), str(n), fill=WHITE, font=f)


def wrap(text, f, max_w, draw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if draw.textbbox((0, 0), test, font=f)[2] <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 180
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # ====== HEADER ======
    hh = 480
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, hh - 50], fill=WHO_BLUE)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh - 50, W, hh], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh, W, hh + 12], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    draw.text((M, 75), "COVID-19 Emergency Response", fill=WHITE, font=font(120, True))
    draw.text((M, 225), "From Detection to Recovery", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(72, True))
    draw.text((M, 340), "WHO-Guided Process Flow  |  A Structured Five-Phase Approach", fill=(190, 215, 240), font=font(42))

    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), "WHO", font=font(58, True))
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 95), "WHO", fill=WHITE, font=font(58, True))
    gt = "World Health Organization"
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), gt, font=font(34))
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 170), gt, fill=(190, 215, 240), font=font(34))

    # ====== INTRO ======
    y = hh + 65
    intro_f = font(40)
    intro = "A step-by-step overview of the WHO-guided process for detecting, responding to, and recovering from COVID-19 outbreaks."
    for l in wrap(intro, intro_f, CW, draw):
        draw.text((M, y), l, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=intro_f)
        y += 58
    y += 35

    # ====== METRICS BAR ======
    mh = 240
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + mh), 24, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)

    metrics = [
        ("194", "Member States\nCoordinated", True, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("~1.9B", "COVAX Doses\nDelivered", True, ACCENT_AMBER),
        ("200+", "Technical Guidance\nDocuments", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("6", "WHO Regions\nCovered", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("Millions", "Dashboard Data\nPoints Daily", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
    ]
    mw = CW // 5
    for i, (val, label, hero, vc) in enumerate(metrics):
        mx = M + i * mw + mw // 2
        vf = font(82 if hero else 60, bold=True)
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), val, font=vf)
        draw.text((mx - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]) // 2, y + 28), val, fill=vc, font=vf)
        lf = font(30)
        for j, ll in enumerate(label.split("\n")):
            bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), ll, font=lf)
            draw.text((mx - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]) // 2, y + 130 + j * 38), ll, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=lf)
        if i < 4:
            sx = M + (i + 1) * mw
            draw.line([(sx, y + 28), (sx, y + mh - 28)], fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, width=2)

    y += mh + 55

    # ====== SECTION TITLE ======
    stf = font(58, True)
    st = "The Five-Phase Response Process"
    draw.text((M, y), st, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=stf)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), st, font=stf)
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 78, M + (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), y + 85], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 110

    # ====== PHASES ======
    phases = [
        {
            "num": 1, "title": "Surveillance & Early Detection", "icon": "DETECT",
            "bullets": [
                "National laboratories report unusual respiratory illness clusters to WHO through the IHR framework",
                "Disease Outbreak News bulletins and Weekly Epidemiological Records keep the global community informed",
            ],
            "callout": "WHO issued its first Disease Outbreak News on 5 January 2020 \u2014 just days after initial reports from Wuhan, China.",
        },
        {
            "num": 2, "title": "Risk Assessment & Alert", "icon": "ASSESS",
            "bullets": [
                "Rapid risk assessments evaluate likelihood of spread, severity of illness, and health system capacity",
                "Situation reports issued regularly; Independent Oversight Committee reviews alert mechanisms",
            ],
            "callout": "30 January 2020: WHO declared COVID-19 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).",
        },
        {
            "num": 3, "title": "Response Operations & Clinical Management", "icon": "RESPOND",
            "bullets": [
                "WHO mobilizes technical teams for infection prevention, clinical management, and health workforce support",
                "Supply chain logistics and research coordination (including the Solidarity Trial) across partner organizations",
            ],
            "callout": "Coordinated through WHO\u2019s Health Emergencies Programme alongside UNICEF, World Bank, and MSF.",
        },
        {
            "num": 4, "title": "Public Health & Social Measures", "icon": "PROTECT",
            "highlight": True,
            "bullets": [
                "Scaled PCR and rapid antigen testing with digital and manual contact tracing systems",
                "Evidence-based quarantine and isolation guidelines, updated as new variants emerged",
                "Mass vaccination campaigns prioritizing health workers and vulnerable populations",
                "Multilingual risk communication campaigns combating misinformation across all channels",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVAX facility delivered approximately 1.9 billion vaccine doses to 146 countries by mid-2023.",
        },
        {
            "num": 5, "title": "Recovery & Health System Resilience", "icon": "RECOVER",
            "bullets": [
                "Restoring routine health services disrupted during the pandemic",
                "Strengthening preparedness through updated national action plans and after-action reviews",
                "Addressing long COVID and mental health impacts on populations worldwide",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVID-19 dashboard tracked millions of data points daily, providing real-time situational awareness worldwide.",
        },
    ]

    spine_x = M + 75
    cl = M + 185
    cr = W - M
    ciw = cr - cl - 65
    cir_r = 50

    body_f = font(36)
    callout_f = font(32)
    lh_body = 48
    lh_call = 44

    for i, ph in enumerate(phases):
        color = PHASE_COLORS[i]
        is_hl = ph.get("highlight", False)
        tf = font(52, True)
        icon_f = font(24, True)

        # calc height
        bullet_h = 0
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 40, draw)
            bullet_h += len(bl) * lh_body + 6

        cl_lines = wrap(ph["callout"], callout_f, ciw - 60, draw)
        call_h = len(cl_lines) * lh_call + 28

        card_h = 80 + bullet_h + 16 + call_h + 36
        if is_hl:
            card_h += 25

        # Shadow + card bg
        if is_hl:
            rrect(draw, (cl + 8, y + 8, cr + 8, y + card_h + 8), 22, fill=(225, 215, 185))
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 22, fill=(255, 249, 233), outline=ACCENT_AMBER, width=6)
        else:
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 22, fill=WHITE, outline=(210, 218, 228), width=3)

        # Left accent bar
        draw.rectangle([cl, y + 22, cl + 12, y + card_h - 22], fill=color)

        # Phase circle
        circle_num(draw, spine_x, y + 55, cir_r, ph["num"], color)

        # Icon pill
        iy = y + 108
        pt = ph["icon"]
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), pt, font=icon_f)
        pw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
        rrect(draw, (spine_x - pw // 2 - 16, iy, spine_x + pw // 2 + 16, iy + 36), 11, fill=color)
        draw.text((spine_x - pw // 2, iy + 4), pt, fill=WHITE, font=icon_f)

        # Highlight badge
        if is_hl:
            bf = font(26, True)
            bt = "KEY PHASE FOR COMMUNITIES"
            bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), bt, font=bf)
            btw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
            bx = cr - btw - 45
            rrect(draw, (bx - 16, y + 18, bx + btw + 16, y + 60), 14, fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
            draw.text((bx, y + 22), bt, fill=WHITE, font=bf)

        # Phase title
        ty = y + 26
        draw.text((cl + 36, ty), f"Phase {ph['num']}: {ph['title']}", fill=color, font=tf)
        ty += 76

        # Bullets
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 40, draw)
            draw.ellipse([cl + 40, ty + 14, cl + 56, ty + 30], fill=color)
            for line in bl:
                draw.text((cl + 66, ty), line, fill=DARK_TEXT, font=body_f)
                ty += lh_body
            ty += 6

        ty += 10

        # Callout
        cbg = (245, 248, 252) if not is_hl else (255, 242, 208)
        cx0, cx1 = cl + 36, cr - 36
        rrect(draw, (cx0, ty, cx1, ty + call_h), 14, fill=cbg)
        draw.rectangle([cx0, ty, cx0 + 6, ty + call_h], fill=color)
        cty = ty + 14
        for cline in cl_lines:
            draw.text((cx0 + 22, cty), cline, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=callout_f)
            cty += lh_call

        # Arrow
        if i < len(phases) - 1:
            a0 = y + card_h + 10
            a1 = y + card_h + 56
            arrow_down(draw, spine_x, a0, a1, (175, 192, 210))
            y = a1 + 14
        else:
            y = y + card_h + 45

    # ====== RESPONSE PILLARS ======
    y += 15
    draw.text((M, y), "Response Pillars (Phase 3 Detail)", fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=font(50, True))
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), "Response Pillars (Phase 3 Detail)", font=font(50, True))
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 68, M + (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), y + 74], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 95

    pillars = [
        ("Infection Prevention\n& Control", "PPE guidance, hand\nhygiene, facility\ndecontamination"),
        ("Clinical\nManagement", "Treatment protocols,\noxygen therapy,\nICU guidelines"),
        ("Health\nWorkforce", "Training, surge staffing,\nmental health support\nfor frontline workers"),
        ("Supply Chain\n& Logistics", "Essential medicines,\ndiagnostics, equipment\nprocurement"),
        ("Research &\nInnovation", "Solidarity Trial, vaccine\nR&D coordination,\ndata sharing"),
    ]

    col_gap = 14
    col_w = (CW - col_gap * 4) // 5
    ptf = font(30, True)
    pbf = font(27)
    pillar_h = 250

    for i, (pt, pd) in enumerate(pillars):
        px = M + i * (col_w + col_gap)
        rrect(draw, (px, y, px + col_w, y + pillar_h), 16, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)
        rrect(draw, (px, y, px + col_w, y + 10), 5, fill=PHASE_COLORS[2])
        pty = y + 22
        for pl in pt.split("\n"):
            draw.text((px + 18, pty), pl, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=ptf)
            pty += 40
        pty += 14
        for pl in pd.split("\n"):
            draw.text((px + 18, pty), pl, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=pbf)
            pty += 36

    y += pillar_h + 50

    # ====== BOTTOM HERO BANNER ======
    bh = 180
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + bh), 20, fill=WHO_BLUE)

    draw.text((M + 50, y + 22), "194 WHO Member States Coordinated", fill=WHITE, font=font(70, True))
    draw.text((M + 50, y + 108), "~1.9 billion COVAX doses delivered to 146 countries by mid-2023", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(40))

    # Accent badge
    cx, cy = W - M - 160, y + bh // 2
    draw.ellipse([cx - 65, cy - 65, cx + 65, cy + 65], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
    draw.ellipse([cx - 55, cy - 55, cx + 55, cy + 55], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
    gf1, gf2 = font(24, True), font(22, True)
    t1, t2 = "GLOBAL", "RESPONSE"
    bbox1 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t1, font=gf1)
    bbox2 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t2, font=gf2)
    draw.text((cx - (bbox1[2] - bbox1[0]) // 2, cy - 22), t1, fill=WHITE, font=gf1)
    draw.text((cx - (bbox2[2] - bbox2[0]) // 2, cy + 8), t2, fill=WHITE, font=gf2)

    y += bh

    # ====== FOOTER ======
    footer_y = H - 190
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, H], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, footer_y + 7], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    ff = font(34)
    ft = "This process flow represents a coordinated global health architecture designed to save lives and build resilience against future pandemics."
    fy = footer_y + 35
    for line in wrap(ft, ff, CW - 250, draw):
        draw.text((M, fy), line, fill=(200, 220, 240), font=ff)
        fy += 48

    draw.text((M, H - 65), "Source: World Health Organization (WHO) | COVID-19 Strategic Preparedness and Response Plan", fill=(140, 170, 200), font=font(28))

    wr = "WHO COVID-19 Response"
    wrf = font(32, True)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), wr, font=wrf)
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), footer_y + 55), wr, fill=WHITE, font=wrf)

    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Done: {W}x{H}px, content ends at y={y}, footer at {footer_y}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate COVID-19 Emergency Response Process Flow poster (A1 portrait)."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 3508, 4961

WHO_BLUE = (0, 114, 188)
WHO_BLUE_DARK = (0, 82, 136)
WHO_BLUE_LIGHT = (230, 243, 250)
WHO_BLUE_MED = (179, 215, 240)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
DARK_TEXT = (33, 37, 41)
GRAY_TEXT = (80, 88, 96)
ACCENT_TEAL = (0, 168, 168)
ACCENT_AMBER = (235, 164, 30)
PHASE_COLORS = [
    (0, 114, 188),
    (0, 148, 180),
    (0, 168, 168),
    (235, 164, 30),
    (76, 175, 80),
]

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(r, (x1 - x0) // 2, (y1 - y0) // 2)
    if r < 1:
        if fill:
            draw.rectangle(xy, fill=fill)
        return
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y1, x1 - r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0 + r, x0, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)


def arrow_down(draw, x, y0, y1, color):
    draw.line([(x, y0), (x, y1)], fill=color, width=6)
    s = 20
    draw.polygon([(x, y1 + s), (x - s, y1 - 2), (x + s, y1 - 2)], fill=color)


def circle_num(draw, cx, cy, r, n, bg):
    draw.ellipse([cx - r - 5, cy - r - 5, cx + r + 5, cy + r + 5], fill=bg)
    f = font(int(r * 1.05), bold=True)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), str(n), font=f)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    draw.text((cx - tw // 2, cy - th // 2 - 4), str(n), fill=WHITE, font=f)


def wrap(text, f, max_w, draw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if draw.textbbox((0, 0), test, font=f)[2] <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 180
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # ====== HEADER ======
    hh = 480
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, hh - 50], fill=WHO_BLUE)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh - 50, W, hh], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh, W, hh + 12], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    draw.text((M, 75), "COVID-19 Emergency Response", fill=WHITE, font=font(120, True))
    draw.text((M, 225), "From Detection to Recovery", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(72, True))
    draw.text((M, 340), "WHO-Guided Process Flow  |  A Structured Five-Phase Approach", fill=(190, 215, 240), font=font(42))

    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), "WHO", font=font(58, True))
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 95), "WHO", fill=WHITE, font=font(58, True))
    gt = "World Health Organization"
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), gt, font=font(34))
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 170), gt, fill=(190, 215, 240), font=font(34))

    # ====== INTRO ======
    y = hh + 65
    intro_f = font(40)
    intro = "A step-by-step overview of the WHO-guided process for detecting, responding to, and recovering from COVID-19 outbreaks."
    for l in wrap(intro, intro_f, CW, draw):
        draw.text((M, y), l, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=intro_f)
        y += 58
    y += 35

    # ====== METRICS BAR ======
    mh = 240
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + mh), 24, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)

    metrics = [
        ("194", "Member States\nCoordinated", True, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("~1.9B", "COVAX Doses\nDelivered", True, ACCENT_AMBER),
        ("200+", "Technical Guidance\nDocuments", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("6", "WHO Regions\nCovered", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("Millions", "Dashboard Data\nPoints Daily", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
    ]
    mw = CW // 5
    for i, (val, label, hero, vc) in enumerate(metrics):
        mx = M + i * mw + mw // 2
        vf = font(82 if hero else 60, bold=True)
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), val, font=vf)
        draw.text((mx - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]) // 2, y + 28), val, fill=vc, font=vf)
        lf = font(30)
        for j, ll in enumerate(label.split("\n")):
            bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), ll, font=lf)
            draw.text((mx - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]) // 2, y + 130 + j * 38), ll, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=lf)
        if i < 4:
            sx = M + (i + 1) * mw
            draw.line([(sx, y + 28), (sx, y + mh - 28)], fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, width=2)

    y += mh + 55

    # ====== SECTION TITLE ======
    stf = font(58, True)
    st = "The Five-Phase Response Process"
    draw.text((M, y), st, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=stf)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), st, font=stf)
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 78, M + (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), y + 85], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 110

    # ====== PHASES ======
    phases = [
        {
            "num": 1, "title": "Surveillance & Early Detection", "icon": "DETECT",
            "bullets": [
                "National laboratories report unusual respiratory illness clusters to WHO through the IHR framework",
                "Disease Outbreak News bulletins and Weekly Epidemiological Records keep the global community informed",
            ],
            "callout": "WHO issued its first Disease Outbreak News on 5 January 2020 \u2014 just days after initial reports from Wuhan, China.",
        },
        {
            "num": 2, "title": "Risk Assessment & Alert", "icon": "ASSESS",
            "bullets": [
                "Rapid risk assessments evaluate likelihood of spread, severity of illness, and health system capacity",
                "Situation reports issued regularly; Independent Oversight Committee reviews alert mechanisms",
            ],
            "callout": "30 January 2020: WHO declared COVID-19 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).",
        },
        {
            "num": 3, "title": "Response Operations & Clinical Management", "icon": "RESPOND",
            "bullets": [
                "WHO mobilizes technical teams for infection prevention, clinical management, and health workforce support",
                "Supply chain logistics and research coordination (including the Solidarity Trial) across partner organizations",
            ],
            "callout": "Coordinated through WHO\u2019s Health Emergencies Programme alongside UNICEF, World Bank, and MSF.",
        },
        {
            "num": 4, "title": "Public Health & Social Measures", "icon": "PROTECT",
            "highlight": True,
            "bullets": [
                "Scaled PCR and rapid antigen testing with digital and manual contact tracing systems",
                "Evidence-based quarantine and isolation guidelines, updated as new variants emerged",
                "Mass vaccination campaigns prioritizing health workers and vulnerable populations",
                "Multilingual risk communication campaigns combating misinformation across all channels",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVAX facility delivered approximately 1.9 billion vaccine doses to 146 countries by mid-2023.",
        },
        {
            "num": 5, "title": "Recovery & Health System Resilience", "icon": "RECOVER",
            "bullets": [
                "Restoring routine health services disrupted during the pandemic",
                "Strengthening preparedness through updated national action plans and after-action reviews",
                "Addressing long COVID and mental health impacts on populations worldwide",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVID-19 dashboard tracked millions of data points daily, providing real-time situational awareness worldwide.",
        },
    ]

    spine_x = M + 75
    cl = M + 185
    cr = W - M
    ciw = cr - cl - 65
    cir_r = 50

    body_f = font(36)
    callout_f = font(32)
    lh_body = 48
    lh_call = 44

    for i, ph in enumerate(phases):
        color = PHASE_COLORS[i]
        is_hl = ph.get("highlight", False)
        tf = font(52, True)
        icon_f = font(24, True)

        # calc height
        bullet_h = 0
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 40, draw)
            bullet_h += len(bl) * lh_body + 6

        cl_lines = wrap(ph["callout"], callout_f, ciw - 60, draw)
        call_h = len(cl_lines) * lh_call + 28

        card_h = 80 + bullet_h + 16 + call_h + 36
        if is_hl:
            card_h += 25

        # Shadow + card bg
        if is_hl:
            rrect(draw, (cl + 8, y + 8, cr + 8, y + card_h + 8), 22, fill=(225, 215, 185))
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 22, fill=(255, 249, 233), outline=ACCENT_AMBER, width=6)
        else:
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 22, fill=WHITE, outline=(210, 218, 228), width=3)

        # Left accent bar
        draw.rectangle([cl, y + 22, cl + 12, y + card_h - 22], fill=color)

        # Phase circle
        circle_num(draw, spine_x, y + 55, cir_r, ph["num"], color)

        # Icon pill
        iy = y + 108
        pt = ph["icon"]
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), pt, font=icon_f)
        pw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
        rrect(draw, (spine_x - pw // 2 - 16, iy, spine_x + pw // 2 + 16, iy + 36), 11, fill=color)
        draw.text((spine_x - pw // 2, iy + 4), pt, fill=WHITE, font=icon_f)

        # Highlight badge
        if is_hl:
            bf = font(26, True)
            bt = "KEY PHASE FOR COMMUNITIES"
            bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), bt, font=bf)
            btw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
            bx = cr - btw - 45
            rrect(draw, (bx - 16, y + 18, bx + btw + 16, y + 60), 14, fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
            draw.text((bx, y + 22), bt, fill=WHITE, font=bf)

        # Phase title
        ty = y + 26
        draw.text((cl + 36, ty), f"Phase {ph['num']}: {ph['title']}", fill=color, font=tf)
        ty += 76

        # Bullets
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 40, draw)
            draw.ellipse([cl + 40, ty + 14, cl + 56, ty + 30], fill=color)
            for line in bl:
                draw.text((cl + 66, ty), line, fill=DARK_TEXT, font=body_f)
                ty += lh_body
            ty += 6

        ty += 10

        # Callout
        cbg = (245, 248, 252) if not is_hl else (255, 242, 208)
        cx0, cx1 = cl + 36, cr - 36
        rrect(draw, (cx0, ty, cx1, ty + call_h), 14, fill=cbg)
        draw.rectangle([cx0, ty, cx0 + 6, ty + call_h], fill=color)
        cty = ty + 14
        for cline in cl_lines:
            draw.text((cx0 + 22, cty), cline, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=callout_f)
            cty += lh_call

        # Arrow
        if i < len(phases) - 1:
            a0 = y + card_h + 10
            a1 = y + card_h + 56
            arrow_down(draw, spine_x, a0, a1, (175, 192, 210))
            y = a1 + 14
        else:
            y = y + card_h + 45

    # ====== RESPONSE PILLARS ======
    y += 15
    draw.text((M, y), "Response Pillars (Phase 3 Detail)", fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=font(50, True))
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), "Response Pillars (Phase 3 Detail)", font=font(50, True))
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 68, M + (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), y + 74], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 95

    pillars = [
        ("Infection Prevention\n& Control", "PPE guidance, hand\nhygiene, facility\ndecontamination"),
        ("Clinical\nManagement", "Treatment protocols,\noxygen therapy,\nICU guidelines"),
        ("Health\nWorkforce", "Training, surge staffing,\nmental health support\nfor frontline workers"),
        ("Supply Chain\n& Logistics", "Essential medicines,\ndiagnostics, equipment\nprocurement"),
        ("Research &\nInnovation", "Solidarity Trial, vaccine\nR&D coordination,\ndata sharing"),
    ]

    col_gap = 14
    col_w = (CW - col_gap * 4) // 5
    ptf = font(30, True)
    pbf = font(27)
    pillar_h = 250

    for i, (pt, pd) in enumerate(pillars):
        px = M + i * (col_w + col_gap)
        rrect(draw, (px, y, px + col_w, y + pillar_h), 16, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)
        rrect(draw, (px, y, px + col_w, y + 10), 5, fill=PHASE_COLORS[2])
        pty = y + 22
        for pl in pt.split("\n"):
            draw.text((px + 18, pty), pl, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=ptf)
            pty += 40
        pty += 14
        for pl in pd.split("\n"):
            draw.text((px + 18, pty), pl, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=pbf)
            pty += 36

    y += pillar_h + 50

    # ====== BOTTOM HERO BANNER ======
    bh = 180
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + bh), 20, fill=WHO_BLUE)

    draw.text((M + 50, y + 22), "194 WHO Member States Coordinated", fill=WHITE, font=font(70, True))
    draw.text((M + 50, y + 108), "~1.9 billion COVAX doses delivered to 146 countries by mid-2023", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(40))

    # Accent badge
    cx, cy = W - M - 160, y + bh // 2
    draw.ellipse([cx - 65, cy - 65, cx + 65, cy + 65], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
    draw.ellipse([cx - 55, cy - 55, cx + 55, cy + 55], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
    gf1, gf2 = font(24, True), font(22, True)
    t1, t2 = "GLOBAL", "RESPONSE"
    bbox1 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t1, font=gf1)
    bbox2 = draw.textbbox((0, 0), t2, font=gf2)
    draw.text((cx - (bbox1[2] - bbox1[0]) // 2, cy - 22), t1, fill=WHITE, font=gf1)
    draw.text((cx - (bbox2[2] - bbox2[0]) // 2, cy + 8), t2, fill=WHITE, font=gf2)

    y += bh

    # ====== FOOTER ======

    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, H], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate COVID-19 Emergency Response Process Flow poster (A1 portrait)."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 3508, 4961

WHO_BLUE = (0, 114, 188)
WHO_BLUE_DARK = (0, 82, 136)
WHO_BLUE_LIGHT = (230, 243, 250)
WHO_BLUE_MED = (179, 215, 240)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
DARK_TEXT = (33, 37, 41)
GRAY_TEXT = (80, 88, 96)
ACCENT_TEAL = (0, 168, 168)
ACCENT_AMBER = (235, 164, 30)
PHASE_COLORS = [
    (0, 114, 188),
    (0, 148, 180),
    (0, 168, 168),
    (235, 164, 30),
    (76, 175, 80),
]

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(r, (x1 - x0) // 2, (y1 - y0) // 2)
    if r < 1:
        if fill:
            draw.rectangle(xy, fill=fill)
        return
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y1, x1 - r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0 + r, x0, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)


def arrow_down(draw, x, y0, y1, color):
    draw.line([(x, y0), (x, y1)], fill=color, width=6)
    s = 20
    draw.polygon([(x, y1 + s), (x - s, y1 - 2), (x + s, y1 - 2)], fill=color)


def circle_num(draw, cx, cy, r, n, bg):
    draw.ellipse([cx - r - 5, cy - r - 5, cx + r + 5, cy + r + 5], fill=bg)
    f = font(int(r * 1.05), bold=True)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), str(n), font=f)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    draw.text((cx - tw // 2, cy - th // 2 - 4), str(n), fill=WHITE, font=f)


def wrap(text, f, max_w, draw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if draw.textbbox((0, 0), test, font=f)[2] <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 180
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # ====== HEADER ======
    hh = 480
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, hh - 50], fill=WHO_BLUE)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh - 50, W, hh], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh, W, hh + 12], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    draw.text((M, 75), "COVID-19 Emergency Response", fill=WHITE, font=font(120, True))
    draw.text((M, 225), "From Detection to Recovery", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(72, True))
    draw.text((M, 340), "WHO-Guided Process Flow  |  A Structured Five-Phase Approach", fill=(190, 215, 240), font=font(42))

    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), "WHO", font=font(58, True))
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 95), "WHO", fill=WHITE, font=font(58, True))
    gt = "World Health Organization"
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), gt, font=font(34))
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 170), gt, fill=(190, 215, 240), font=font(34))

    # ====== INTRO ======
    y = hh + 65
    intro_f = font(40)
    intro = "A step-by-step overview of the WHO-guided process for detecting, responding to, and recovering from COVID-19 outbreaks."
    for l in wrap(intro, intro_f, CW, draw):
        draw.text((M, y), l, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=intro_f)
        y += 58
    y += 35

    # ====== METRICS BAR ======
    mh = 240
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + mh), 24, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)

    metrics = [
        ("194", "Member States\nCoordinated", True, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("~1.9B", "COVAX Doses\nDelivered", True, ACCENT_AMBER),
        ("200+", "Technical Guidance\nDocuments", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("6", "WHO Regions\nCovered", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("Millions", "Dashboard Data\nPoints Daily", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
    ]
    mw = CW // 5
    for i, (val, label, hero, vc) in enumerate(metrics):
        mx = M + i * mw + mw // 2
        vf = font(82 if hero else 60, bold=True)
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), val, font=vf)
        draw.text((mx - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]) // 2, y + 28), val, fill=vc, font=vf)
        lf = font(30)
        for j, ll in enumerate(label.split("\n")):
            bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), ll, font=lf)
            draw.text((mx - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]) // 2, y + 130 + j * 38), ll, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=lf)
        if i < 4:
            sx = M + (i + 1) * mw
            draw.line([(sx, y + 28), (sx, y + mh - 28)], fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, width=2)

    y += mh + 55

    # ====== SECTION TITLE ======
    stf = font(58, True)
    st = "The Five-Phase Response Process"
    draw.text((M, y), st, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=stf)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), st, font=stf)
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 78, M + (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), y + 85], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 110

    # ====== PHASES ======
    phases = [
        {
            "num": 1, "title": "Surveillance & Early Detection", "icon": "DETECT",
            "bullets": [
                "National laboratories report unusual respiratory illness clusters to WHO through the IHR framework",
                "Disease Outbreak News bulletins and Weekly Epidemiological Records keep the global community informed",
            ],
            "callout": "WHO issued its first Disease Outbreak News on 5 January 2020 \u2014 just days after initial reports from Wuhan, China.",
        },
        {
            "num": 2, "title": "Risk Assessment & Alert", "icon": "ASSESS",
            "bullets": [
                "Rapid risk assessments evaluate likelihood of spread, severity of illness, and health system capacity",
                "Situation reports issued regularly; Independent Oversight Committee reviews alert mechanisms",
            ],
            "callout": "30 January 2020: WHO declared COVID-19 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).",
        },
        {
            "num": 3, "title": "Response Operations & Clinical Management", "icon": "RESPOND",
            "bullets": [
                "WHO mobilizes technical teams for infection prevention, clinical management, and health workforce support",
                "Supply chain logistics and research coordination (including the Solidarity Trial) across partner organizations",
            ],
            "callout": "Coordinated through WHO\u2019s Health Emergencies Programme alongside UNICEF, World Bank, and MSF.",
        },
        {
            "num": 4, "title": "Public Health & Social Measures", "icon": "PROTECT",
            "highlight": True,
            "bullets": [
                "Scaled PCR and rapid antigen testing with digital and manual contact tracing systems",
                "Evidence-based quarantine and isolation guidelines, updated as new variants emerged",
                "Mass vaccination campaigns prioritizing health workers and vulnerable populations",
                "Multilingual risk communication campaigns combating misinformation across all channels",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVAX facility delivered approximately 1.9 billion vaccine doses to 146 countries by mid-2023.",
        },
        {
            "num": 5, "title": "Recovery & Health System Resilience", "icon": "RECOVER",
            "bullets": [
                "Restoring routine health services disrupted during the pandemic",
                "Strengthening preparedness through updated national action plans and after-action reviews",
                "Addressing long COVID and mental health impacts on populations worldwide",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVID-19 dashboard tracked millions of data points daily, providing real-time situational awareness worldwide.",
        },
    ]

    spine_x = M + 75
    cl = M + 185
    cr = W - M
    ciw = cr - cl - 65
    cir_r = 50

    body_f = font(36)
    callout_f = font(32)
    lh_body = 48
    lh_call = 44

    for i, ph in enumerate(phases):
        color = PHASE_COLORS[i]
        is_hl = ph.get("highlight", False)
        tf = font(52, True)
        icon_f = font(24, True)

        # calc height
        bullet_h = 0
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 40, draw)
            bullet_h += len(bl) * lh_body + 6

        cl_lines = wrap(ph["callout"], callout_f, ciw - 60, draw)
        call_h = len(cl_lines) * lh_call + 28

        card_h = 80 + bullet_h + 16 + call_h + 36
        if is_hl:
            card_h += 25

        # Shadow + card bg
        if is_hl:
            rrect(draw, (cl + 8, y + 8, cr + 8, y + card_h + 8), 22, fill=(225, 215, 185))
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 22, fill=(255, 249, 233), outline=ACCENT_AMBER, width=6)
        else:
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 22, fill=WHITE, outline=(210, 218, 228), width=3)

        # Left accent bar
        draw.rectangle([cl, y + 22, cl + 12, y + card_h - 22], fill=color)

        # Phase circle
        circle_num(draw, spine_x, y + 55, cir_r, ph["num"], color)

        # Icon pill
        iy = y + 108
        pt = ph["icon"]
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), pt, font=icon_f)
        pw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
        rrect(draw, (spine_x - pw // 2 - 16, iy, spine_x + pw // 2 + 16, iy + 36), 11, fill=color)
        draw.text((spine_x - pw // 2, iy + 4), pt, fill=WHITE, font=icon_f)

        # Highlight badge
        if is_hl:
            bf = font(26, True)
            bt = "KEY PHASE FOR COMMUNITIES"
            bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), bt, font=bf)
            btw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
            bx = cr - btw - 45
            rrect(draw, (bx - 16, y + 18, bx + btw + 16, y + 60), 14, fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
            draw.text((bx, y + 22), bt, fill=WHITE, font=bf)

        # Phase title
        ty = y + 26
        draw.text((cl + 36, ty), f"Phase {ph['num']}: {ph['title']}", fill=color, font=tf)
        ty += 76

        # Bullets
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 40, draw)
            draw.ellipse([cl + 40, ty + 14, cl + 56, ty + 30], fill=color)
            for line in bl:
                draw.text((cl + 66, ty), line, fill=DARK_TEXT, font=body_f)
                ty += lh_body
            ty += 6

        ty += 10

        # Callout
        cbg = (245, 248, 252) if not is_hl else (255, 242, 208)
        cx0, cx1 = cl + 36, cr - 36

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate COVID-19 Emergency Response Process Flow poster (A1 portrait)."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 3508, 4961

WHO_BLUE = (0, 114, 188)
WHO_BLUE_DARK = (0, 82, 136)
WHO_BLUE_LIGHT = (230, 243, 250)
WHO_BLUE_MED = (179, 215, 240)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
DARK_TEXT = (33, 37, 41)
GRAY_TEXT = (80, 88, 96)
ACCENT_TEAL = (0, 168, 168)
ACCENT_AMBER = (235, 164, 30)
PHASE_COLORS = [
    (0, 114, 188),
    (0, 148, 180),
    (0, 168, 168),
    (235, 164, 30),
    (76, 175, 80),
]

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(r, (x1 - x0) // 2, (y1 - y0) // 2)
    if r < 1:
        if fill:
            draw.rectangle(xy, fill=fill)
        return
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y1, x1 - r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0 + r, x0, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)


def arrow_down(draw, x, y0, y1, color):
    draw.line([(x, y0), (x, y1)], fill=color, width=6)
    s = 20
    draw.polygon([(x, y1 + s), (x - s, y1 - 2), (x + s, y1 - 2)], fill=color)


def circle_num(draw, cx, cy, r, n, bg):
    draw.ellipse([cx - r - 6, cy - r - 6, cx + r + 6, cy + r + 6], fill=bg)
    f = font(int(r * 1.05), bold=True)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), str(n), font=f)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    draw.text((cx - tw // 2, cy - th // 2 - 4), str(n), fill=WHITE, font=f)


def wrap(text, f, max_w, draw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if draw.textbbox((0, 0), test, font=f)[2] <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def text_w(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 180
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # ====== HEADER ======

    draw.rectangle([0, hh - 50, W, hh], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)

    # ====== INTRO ======
    y = hh + 70
    intro_f = font(42)
    intro = "A step-by-step overview of the WHO-guided process for detecting, responding to, and recovering from COVID-19 outbreaks."
    for l in wrap(intro, intro_f, CW, draw):
        draw.text((M, y), l, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=intro_f)
        y += 60
    y += 40

    # ====== METRICS BAR ======
    mh = 260
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + mh), 24, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)

    metrics = [
        ("194", "Member States\nCoordinated", True, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("~1.9B", "COVAX Doses\nDelivered", True, ACCENT_AMBER),
        ("200+", "Technical Guidance\nDocuments", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("6", "WHO Regions\nCovered", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("Millions", "Dashboard Data\nPoints Daily", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
    ]
    mw = CW // 5
    for i, (val, label, hero, vc) in enumerate(metrics):
        mx = M + i * mw + mw // 2
        vf = font(90 if hero else 66, bold=True)
        draw.text((mx - text_w(draw, val, vf) // 2, y + 30), val, fill=vc, font=vf)
        lf = font(32)
        for j, ll in enumerate(label.split("\n")):
            draw.text((mx - text_w(draw, ll, lf) // 2, y + 145 + j * 40), ll, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=lf)
        if i < 4:
            sx = M + (i + 1) * mw
            draw.line([(sx, y + 30), (sx, y + mh - 30)], fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, width=2)

    y += mh + 65

    # ====== SECTION TITLE ======
    stf = font(62, True)
    st = "The Five-Phase Response Process"
    draw.text((M, y), st, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=stf)
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 82, M + text_w(draw, st, stf), y + 90], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 120

    # ====== PHASES ======
    phases = [
        {
            "num": 1, "title": "Surveillance & Early Detection", "icon": "DETECT",
            "bullets": [

        },
        {

            "bullets": [

            ],
            "callout": "Coordinated through WHO\u2019s Health Emergencies Programme alongside UNICEF, World Bank, and MSF.",
        },
        {
            "num": 4, "title": "Public Health & Social Measures", "icon": "PROTECT",
            "highlight": True,
            "bullets": [
                "Scaled PCR and rapid antigen testing with digital and manual contact tracing systems",
                "Evidence-based quarantine and isolation guidelines, updated as new variants emerged",
                "Mass vaccination campaigns prioritizing health workers and vulnerable populations",
                "Multilingual risk communication campaigns combating misinformation across all channels",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVAX facility delivered approximately 1.9 billion vaccine doses to 146 countries by mid-2023.",
        },
        {
            "num": 5, "title": "Recovery & Health System Resilience", "icon": "RECOVER",
            "bullets": [
                "Restoring routine health services disrupted during the pandemic",
                "Strengthening preparedness through updated national action plans and after-action reviews",
                "Addressing long COVID and mental health impacts on populations worldwide",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVID-19 dashboard tracked millions of data points daily, providing real-time situational awareness worldwide.",
        },
    ]

    spine_x = M + 80
    cl = M + 200
    cr = W - M
    ciw = cr - cl - 70
    cir_r = 54

    body_f = font(38)
    callout_f = font(34)
    lh_body = 52
    lh_call = 48
    arrow_gap = 75

    for i, ph in enumerate(phases):
        color = PHASE_COLORS[i]
        is_hl = ph.get("highlight", False)
        tf = font(54, True)
        icon_f = font(26, True)

        bullet_h = 0
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 50, draw)

    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y1, x1 - r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0 + r, x0, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)


def arrow_down(draw, x, y0, y1, color):
    draw.line([(x, y0), (x, y1)], fill=color, width=6)
    s = 20
    draw.polygon([(x, y1 + s), (x - s, y1 - 2), (x + s, y1 - 2)], fill=color)


def circle_num(draw, cx, cy, r, n, bg):
    draw.ellipse([cx - r - 6, cy - r - 6, cx + r + 6, cy + r + 6], fill=bg)
    f = font(int(r * 1.05), bold=True)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), str(n), font=f)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    draw.text((cx - tw // 2, cy - th // 2 - 4), str(n), fill=WHITE, font=f)


def wrap(text, f, max_w, draw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if draw.textbbox((0, 0), test, font=f)[2] <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def text_w(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 180
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # ====== HEADER ======
    hh = 500
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, hh - 50], fill=WHO_BLUE)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh - 50, W, hh], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh, W, hh + 12], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    draw.text((M, 80), "COVID-19 Emergency", fill=WHITE, font=font(130, True))
    draw.text((M, 230), "Response", fill=WHITE, font=font(130, True))
    draw.text((M, 370), "From Detection to Recovery", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(60, True))

    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), "WHO", font=font(64, True))
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 100), "WHO", fill=WHITE, font=font(64, True))
    gt = "World Health Organization"
    draw.text((W - M - text_w(draw, gt, font(34)), 180), gt, fill=(190, 215, 240), font=font(34))

    # ====== INTRO ======
    y = hh + 70
    intro_f = font(42)
    intro = "A step-by-step overview of the WHO-guided process for detecting, responding to, and recovering from COVID-19 outbreaks."
    for l in wrap(intro, intro_f, CW, draw):
        draw.text((M, y), l, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=intro_f)
        y += 60
    y += 40

    # ====== METRICS BAR ======
    mh = 260
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + mh), 24, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)

    metrics = [
        ("194", "Member States\nCoordinated", True, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("~1.9B", "COVAX Doses\nDelivered", True, ACCENT_AMBER),
        ("200+", "Technical Guidance\nDocuments", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("6", "WHO Regions\nCovered", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("Millions", "Dashboard Data\nPoints Daily", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
    ]
    mw = CW // 5
    for i, (val, label, hero, vc) in enumerate(metrics):
        mx = M + i * mw + mw // 2
        vf = font(90 if hero else 66, bold=True)
        draw.text((mx - text_w(draw, val, vf) // 2, y + 30), val, fill=vc, font=vf)
        lf = font(32)
        for j, ll in enumerate(label.split("\n")):
            draw.text((mx - text_w(draw, ll, lf) // 2, y + 145 + j * 40), ll, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=lf)
        if i < 4:
            sx = M + (i + 1) * mw
            draw.line([(sx, y + 30), (sx, y + mh - 30)], fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, width=2)

    y += mh + 65

    # ====== SECTION TITLE ======
    stf = font(62, True)
    st = "The Five-Phase Response Process"
    draw.text((M, y), st, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=stf)
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 82, M + text_w(draw, st, stf), y + 90], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 120

    # ====== PHASES ======
    phases = [
        {
            "num": 1, "title": "Surveillance & Early Detection", "icon": "DETECT",
            "bullets": [
                "National laboratories report unusual respiratory illness clusters to WHO through the International Health Regulations (IHR) framework",
                "Disease Outbreak News bulletins and Weekly Epidemiological Records keep the global community informed",
            ],
            "callout": "WHO issued its first Disease Outbreak News on 5 January 2020 \u2014 just days after initial reports from Wuhan, China.",
        },
        {
            "num": 2, "title": "Risk Assessment & Alert", "icon": "ASSESS",
            "bullets": [
                "Rapid risk assessments evaluate likelihood of spread, severity of illness, and health system capacity",
                "Situation reports issued regularly; Independent Oversight Committee reviews alert mechanisms",
            ],
            "callout": "30 January 2020: WHO declared COVID-19 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).",
        },
        {
            "num": 3, "title": "Response Operations & Clinical Management", "icon": "RESPOND",
            "bullets": [
                "WHO mobilizes technical teams for infection prevention, clinical management, and health workforce support",
                "Supply chain logistics and research coordination (including the Solidarity Trial) across partner organizations",
            ],
            "callout": "Coordinated through WHO\u2019s Health Emergencies Programme alongside UNICEF, World Bank, and MSF.",
        },
        {
            "num": 4, "title": "Public Health & Social Measures", "icon": "PROTECT",
            "highlight": True,
            "bullets": [
                "Scaled PCR and rapid antigen testing with digital and manual contact tracing systems",
                "Evidence-based quarantine and isolation guidelines, updated as new variants emerged",
                "Mass vaccination campaigns prioritizing health workers and vulnerable populations",
                "Multilingual risk communication campaigns combating misinformation across all channels",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVAX facility delivered approximately 1.9 billion vaccine doses to 146 countries by mid-2023.",
        },
        {
            "num": 5, "title": "Recovery & Health System Resilience", "icon": "RECOVER",
            "bullets": [
                "Restoring routine health services disrupted during the pandemic",
                "Strengthening preparedness through updated national action plans and after-action reviews",
                "Addressing long COVID and mental health impacts on populations worldwide",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVID-19 dashboard tracked millions of data points daily, providing real-time situational awareness worldwide.",
        },
    ]

    spine_x = M + 80
    cl = M + 200
    cr = W - M
    ciw = cr - cl - 70
    cir_r = 54

    body_f = font(38)
    callout_f = font(34)
    lh_body = 52
    lh_call = 48
    arrow_gap = 75

    for i, ph in enumerate(phases):
        color = PHASE_COLORS[i]
        is_hl = ph.get("highlight", False)
        tf = font(54, True)
        icon_f = font(26, True)

        bullet_h = 0
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 50, draw)
            bullet_h += len(bl) * lh_body + 8

        cl_lines = wrap(ph["callout"], callout_f, ciw - 70, draw)
        call_h = len(cl_lines) * lh_call + 32

        card_h = 90 + bullet_h + 20 + call_h + 40
        if is_hl:
            card_h += 30

        # Card
        if is_hl:
            rrect(draw, (cl + 10, y + 10, cr + 10, y + card_h + 10), 24, fill=(220, 210, 180))
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 24, fill=(255, 249, 233), outline=ACCENT_AMBER, width=6)
        else:
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 24, fill=WHITE, outline=(208, 216, 228), width=3)

        # Accent bar
        draw.rectangle([cl, y + 24, cl + 14, y + card_h - 24], fill=color)

        # Circle
        circle_num(draw, spine_x, y + 60, cir_r, ph["num"], color)

        # Icon pill
        iy = y + 118
        pt = ph["icon"]
        pw = text_w(draw, pt, icon_f)
        rrect(draw, (spine_x - pw // 2 - 18, iy, spine_x + pw // 2 + 18, iy + 38), 12, fill=color)
        draw.text((spine_x - pw // 2, iy + 5), pt, fill=WHITE, font=icon_f)

        # Highlight badge
        if is_hl:
            bf = font(28, True)
            bt = "KEY PHASE FOR COMMUNITIES"
            btw = text_w(draw, bt, bf)
            bx = cr - btw - 50
            rrect(draw, (bx - 18, y + 20, bx + btw + 18, y + 64), 14, fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
            draw.text((bx, y + 24), bt, fill=WHITE, font=bf)

        # Title
        ty = y + 28
        draw.text((cl + 40, ty), f"Phase {ph['num']}: {ph['title']}", fill=color, font=tf)
        ty += 82

        # Bullets
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 50, draw)
            draw.ellipse([cl + 44, ty + 16, cl + 62, ty + 34], fill=color)
            for line in bl:
                draw.text((cl + 74, ty), line, fill=DARK_TEXT, font=body_f)
                ty += lh_body
            ty += 8

        ty += 12

        # Callout box
        cbg = (245, 248, 252) if not is_hl else (255, 242, 208)
        cx0, cx1 = cl + 40, cr - 40
        rrect(draw, (cx0, ty, cx1, ty + call_h), 14, fill=cbg)
        draw.rectangle([cx0, ty, cx0 + 7, ty + call_h], fill=color)
        cty = ty + 16
        for cline in cl_lines:
            draw.text((cx0 + 26, cty), cline, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=callout_f)
            cty += lh_call

        # Arrow
        if i < len(phases) - 1:
            a0 = y + card_h + 12
            a1 = y + card_h + arrow_gap - 10
            arrow_down(draw, spine_x, a0, a1, (175, 192, 210))
            y = a1 + 16
        else:
            y = y + card_h + 55

    # ====== RESPONSE PILLARS ======
    y += 20
    ptf_title = font(54, True)
    pt_label = "Response Pillars (Phase 3 Detail)"
    draw.text((M, y), pt_label, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=ptf_title)
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 72, M + text_w(draw, pt_label, ptf_title), y + 79], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 105

    pillars = [
        ("Infection Prevention\n& Control", "PPE guidance, hand\nhygiene, facility\ndecontamination"),
        ("Clinical\nManagement", "Treatment protocols,\noxygen therapy,\nICU guidelines"),
        ("Health\nWorkforce", "Training, surge staffing,\nmental health support\nfor frontline workers"),
        ("Supply Chain\n& Logistics", "Essential medicines,\ndiagnostics, equipment\nprocurement"),
        ("Research &\nInnovation", "Solidarity Trial, vaccine\nR&D coordination,\ndata sharing"),
    ]

    col_gap = 16
    col_w = (CW - col_gap * 4) // 5
    ptf = font(32, True)
    pbf = font(28)
    pillar_h = 280

    for i, (pt, pd) in enumerate(pillars):
        px = M + i * (col_w + col_gap)
        rrect(draw, (px, y, px + col_w, y + pillar_h), 18, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)
        rrect(draw, (px, y, px + col_w, y + 12), 6, fill=PHASE_COLORS[2])
        pty = y + 28
        for pl in pt.split("\n"):
            draw.text((px + 20, pty), pl, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=ptf)
            pty += 44
        pty += 18
        for pl in pd.split("\n"):
            draw.text((px + 20, pty), pl, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=pbf)
            pty += 38

    y += pillar_h + 60

    # ====== BOTTOM HERO BANNER ======
    bh = 200
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + bh), 22, fill=WHO_BLUE)

    draw.text((M + 55, y + 28), "194 WHO Member States Coordinated", fill=WHITE, font=font(76, True))
    draw.text((M + 55, y + 120), "~1.9 billion COVAX doses delivered to 146 countries by mid-2023", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(42))

    # Accent circle
    cx, cy = W - M - 180, y + bh // 2
    draw.ellipse([cx - 72, cy - 72, cx + 72, cy + 72], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
    gf1, gf2 = font(28, True), font(24, True)
    t1, t2 = "GLOBAL", "RESPONSE"
    draw.text((cx - text_w(draw, t1, gf1) // 2, cy - 24), t1, fill=WHITE, font=gf1)
    draw.text((cx - text_w(draw, t2, gf2) // 2, cy + 10), t2, fill=WHITE, font=gf2)

    y += bh

    # ====== FOOTER ======
    footer_y = H - 200
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, H], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, footer_y + 8], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    ff = font(36)
    ft = "This process flow represents a coordinated global health architecture designed to save lives and build resilience against future pandemics."
    fy = footer_y + 38
    for line in wrap(ft, ff, CW - 300, draw):
        draw.text((M, fy), line, fill=(200, 220, 240), font=ff)
        fy += 50

    draw.text((M, H - 68), "Source: World Health Organization (WHO) | COVID-19 Strategic Preparedness and Response Plan", fill=(140, 170, 200), font=font(30))

    wr = "WHO COVID-19 Response"
    wrf = font(34, True)
    draw.text((W - M - text_w(draw, wr, wrf), footer_y + 60), wr, fill=WHITE, font=wrf)

    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Done: {W}x{H}px, content_end={y}, footer={footer_y}, gap={footer_y - y}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate COVID-19 Emergency Response Process Flow poster (A1 portrait)."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 3508, 4961

WHO_BLUE = (0, 114, 188)
WHO_BLUE_DARK = (0, 82, 136)
WHO_BLUE_LIGHT = (230, 243, 250)
WHO_BLUE_MED = (179, 215, 240)
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
DARK_TEXT = (33, 37, 41)
GRAY_TEXT = (80, 88, 96)
ACCENT_TEAL = (0, 168, 168)
ACCENT_AMBER = (235, 164, 30)
PHASE_COLORS = [
    (0, 114, 188),
    (0, 148, 180),
    (0, 168, 168),
    (235, 164, 30),
    (76, 175, 80),
]

FONT_BOLD = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"


def font(size, bold=False):
    return ImageFont.truetype(FONT_BOLD if bold else FONT_REG, size)


def rrect(draw, xy, r, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    r = min(r, (x1 - x0) // 2, (y1 - y0) // 2)
    if r < 1:
        if fill:
            draw.rectangle(xy, fill=fill)
        return
    if fill:
        draw.rectangle([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y1], fill=fill)
        draw.rectangle([x0, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=fill)
        draw.pieslice([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=fill)
    if outline:
        draw.arc([x0, y0, x0 + 2*r, y0 + 2*r], 180, 270, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y0, x1, y0 + 2*r], 270, 360, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x0, y1 - 2*r, x0 + 2*r, y1], 90, 180, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.arc([x1 - 2*r, y1 - 2*r, x1, y1], 0, 90, fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y0, x1 - r, y0], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0 + r, y1, x1 - r, y1], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x0, y0 + r, x0, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)
        draw.line([x1, y0 + r, x1, y1 - r], fill=outline, width=width)


def arrow_down(draw, x, y0, y1, color):
    draw.line([(x, y0), (x, y1)], fill=color, width=6)
    s = 20
    draw.polygon([(x, y1 + s), (x - s, y1 - 2), (x + s, y1 - 2)], fill=color)


def circle_num(draw, cx, cy, r, n, bg):
    draw.ellipse([cx - r - 6, cy - r - 6, cx + r + 6, cy + r + 6], fill=bg)
    f = font(int(r * 1.05), bold=True)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), str(n), font=f)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    th = bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    draw.text((cx - tw // 2, cy - th // 2 - 4), str(n), fill=WHITE, font=f)


def wrap(text, f, max_w, draw):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], ""
    for w in words:
        test = f"{cur} {w}".strip()
        if draw.textbbox((0, 0), test, font=f)[2] <= max_w:
            cur = test
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(cur)
            cur = w
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
    return lines


def text_w(draw, text, f):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]


def main():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    M = 180
    CW = W - 2 * M

    # ====== HEADER ======
    hh = 500
    draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, hh - 50], fill=WHO_BLUE)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh - 50, W, hh], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)
    draw.rectangle([0, hh, W, hh + 12], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    draw.text((M, 80), "COVID-19 Emergency", fill=WHITE, font=font(130, True))
    draw.text((M, 230), "Response", fill=WHITE, font=font(130, True))
    draw.text((M, 370), "From Detection to Recovery", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(60, True))

    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), "WHO", font=font(64, True))
    draw.text((W - M - (bbox[2] - bbox[0]), 100), "WHO", fill=WHITE, font=font(64, True))
    gt = "World Health Organization"
    draw.text((W - M - text_w(draw, gt, font(34)), 180), gt, fill=(190, 215, 240), font=font(34))

    # ====== INTRO ======
    y = hh + 70
    intro_f = font(42)
    intro = "A step-by-step overview of the WHO-guided process for detecting, responding to, and recovering from COVID-19 outbreaks."
    for l in wrap(intro, intro_f, CW, draw):
        draw.text((M, y), l, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=intro_f)
        y += 60
    y += 40

    # ====== METRICS BAR ======
    mh = 260
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + mh), 24, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)

    metrics = [
        ("194", "Member States\nCoordinated", True, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("~1.9B", "COVAX Doses\nDelivered", True, ACCENT_AMBER),
        ("200+", "Technical Guidance\nDocuments", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("6", "WHO Regions\nCovered", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
        ("Millions", "Dashboard Data\nPoints Daily", False, WHO_BLUE_DARK),
    ]
    mw = CW // 5
    for i, (val, label, hero, vc) in enumerate(metrics):
        mx = M + i * mw + mw // 2
        vf = font(90 if hero else 66, bold=True)
        draw.text((mx - text_w(draw, val, vf) // 2, y + 30), val, fill=vc, font=vf)
        lf = font(32)
        for j, ll in enumerate(label.split("\n")):
            draw.text((mx - text_w(draw, ll, lf) // 2, y + 145 + j * 40), ll, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=lf)
        if i < 4:
            sx = M + (i + 1) * mw
            draw.line([(sx, y + 30), (sx, y + mh - 30)], fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, width=2)

    y += mh + 65

    # ====== SECTION TITLE ======
    stf = font(62, True)
    st = "The Five-Phase Response Process"
    draw.text((M, y), st, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=stf)
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 82, M + text_w(draw, st, stf), y + 90], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 120

    # ====== PHASES ======
    phases = [
        {
            "num": 1, "title": "Surveillance & Early Detection", "icon": "DETECT",
            "bullets": [
                "National laboratories report unusual respiratory illness clusters to WHO through the International Health Regulations (IHR) framework",
                "Disease Outbreak News bulletins and Weekly Epidemiological Records keep the global community informed",
            ],
            "callout": "WHO issued its first Disease Outbreak News on 5 January 2020 \u2014 just days after initial reports from Wuhan, China.",
        },
        {
            "num": 2, "title": "Risk Assessment & Alert", "icon": "ASSESS",
            "bullets": [
                "Rapid risk assessments evaluate likelihood of spread, severity of illness, and health system capacity",
                "Situation reports issued regularly; Independent Oversight Committee reviews alert mechanisms",
            ],
            "callout": "30 January 2020: WHO declared COVID-19 a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).",
        },
        {
            "num": 3, "title": "Response Operations & Clinical Management", "icon": "RESPOND",
            "bullets": [
                "WHO mobilizes technical teams for infection prevention, clinical management, and health workforce support",
                "Supply chain logistics and research coordination (including the Solidarity Trial) across partner organizations",
            ],
            "callout": "Coordinated through WHO\u2019s Health Emergencies Programme alongside UNICEF, World Bank, and MSF.",
        },
        {
            "num": 4, "title": "Public Health & Social Measures", "icon": "PROTECT",
            "highlight": True,
            "bullets": [
                "Scaled PCR and rapid antigen testing with digital and manual contact tracing systems",
                "Evidence-based quarantine and isolation guidelines, updated as new variants emerged",
                "Mass vaccination campaigns prioritizing health workers and vulnerable populations",
                "Multilingual risk communication campaigns combating misinformation across all channels",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVAX facility delivered approximately 1.9 billion vaccine doses to 146 countries by mid-2023.",
        },
        {
            "num": 5, "title": "Recovery & Health System Resilience", "icon": "RECOVER",
            "bullets": [
                "Restoring routine health services disrupted during the pandemic",
                "Strengthening preparedness through updated national action plans and after-action reviews",
                "Addressing long COVID and mental health impacts on populations worldwide",
            ],
            "callout": "The COVID-19 dashboard tracked millions of data points daily, providing real-time situational awareness worldwide.",
        },
    ]

    spine_x = M + 80
    cl = M + 200
    cr = W - M
    ciw = cr - cl - 70
    cir_r = 54

    body_f = font(38)
    callout_f = font(34)
    lh_body = 52
    lh_call = 48
    arrow_gap = 75

    for i, ph in enumerate(phases):
        color = PHASE_COLORS[i]
        is_hl = ph.get("highlight", False)
        tf = font(54, True)
        icon_f = font(26, True)

        bullet_h = 0
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 50, draw)
            bullet_h += len(bl) * lh_body + 8

        cl_lines = wrap(ph["callout"], callout_f, ciw - 70, draw)
        call_h = len(cl_lines) * lh_call + 32

        card_h = 90 + bullet_h + 20 + call_h + 40
        if is_hl:
            card_h += 30

        # Card
        if is_hl:
            rrect(draw, (cl + 10, y + 10, cr + 10, y + card_h + 10), 24, fill=(220, 210, 180))
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 24, fill=(255, 249, 233), outline=ACCENT_AMBER, width=6)
        else:
            rrect(draw, (cl, y, cr, y + card_h), 24, fill=WHITE, outline=(208, 216, 228), width=3)

        # Accent bar
        draw.rectangle([cl, y + 24, cl + 14, y + card_h - 24], fill=color)

        # Circle
        circle_num(draw, spine_x, y + 60, cir_r, ph["num"], color)

        # Icon pill
        iy = y + 118
        pt = ph["icon"]
        pw = text_w(draw, pt, icon_f)
        rrect(draw, (spine_x - pw // 2 - 18, iy, spine_x + pw // 2 + 18, iy + 38), 12, fill=color)
        draw.text((spine_x - pw // 2, iy + 5), pt, fill=WHITE, font=icon_f)

        # Highlight badge
        if is_hl:
            bf = font(28, True)
            bt = "KEY PHASE FOR COMMUNITIES"
            btw = text_w(draw, bt, bf)
            bx = cr - btw - 50
            rrect(draw, (bx - 18, y + 20, bx + btw + 18, y + 64), 14, fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
            draw.text((bx, y + 24), bt, fill=WHITE, font=bf)

        # Title
        ty = y + 28
        draw.text((cl + 40, ty), f"Phase {ph['num']}: {ph['title']}", fill=color, font=tf)
        ty += 82

        # Bullets
        for b in ph["bullets"]:
            bl = wrap(b, body_f, ciw - 50, draw)
            draw.ellipse([cl + 44, ty + 16, cl + 62, ty + 34], fill=color)
            for line in bl:
                draw.text((cl + 74, ty), line, fill=DARK_TEXT, font=body_f)
                ty += lh_body
            ty += 8

        ty += 12

        # Callout box
        cbg = (245, 248, 252) if not is_hl else (255, 242, 208)
        cx0, cx1 = cl + 40, cr - 40
        rrect(draw, (cx0, ty, cx1, ty + call_h), 14, fill=cbg)
        draw.rectangle([cx0, ty, cx0 + 7, ty + call_h], fill=color)
        cty = ty + 16
        for cline in cl_lines:
            draw.text((cx0 + 26, cty), cline, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=callout_f)
            cty += lh_call

        # Arrow
        if i < len(phases) - 1:
            a0 = y + card_h + 12
            a1 = y + card_h + arrow_gap - 10
            arrow_down(draw, spine_x, a0, a1, (175, 192, 210))
            y = a1 + 16
        else:
            y = y + card_h + 55

    # ====== RESPONSE PILLARS ======
    y += 20
    ptf_title = font(54, True)
    pt_label = "Response Pillars (Phase 3 Detail)"
    draw.text((M, y), pt_label, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=ptf_title)
    draw.rectangle([M, y + 72, M + text_w(draw, pt_label, ptf_title), y + 79], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
    y += 105

    pillars = [
        ("Infection Prevention\n& Control", "PPE guidance, hand\nhygiene, facility\ndecontamination"),
        ("Clinical\nManagement", "Treatment protocols,\noxygen therapy,\nICU guidelines"),
        ("Health\nWorkforce", "Training, surge staffing,\nmental health support\nfor frontline workers"),
        ("Supply Chain\n& Logistics", "Essential medicines,\ndiagnostics, equipment\nprocurement"),
        ("Research &\nInnovation", "Solidarity Trial, vaccine\nR&D coordination,\ndata sharing"),
    ]

    col_gap = 16
    col_w = (CW - col_gap * 4) // 5
    ptf = font(32, True)
    pbf = font(28)
    pillar_h = 280

    for i, (pt, pd) in enumerate(pillars):
        px = M + i * (col_w + col_gap)
        rrect(draw, (px, y, px + col_w, y + pillar_h), 18, fill=WHO_BLUE_LIGHT)
        rrect(draw, (px, y, px + col_w, y + 12), 6, fill=PHASE_COLORS[2])
        pty = y + 28
        for pl in pt.split("\n"):
            draw.text((px + 20, pty), pl, fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK, font=ptf)
            pty += 44
        pty += 18
        for pl in pd.split("\n"):
            draw.text((px + 20, pty), pl, fill=GRAY_TEXT, font=pbf)
            pty += 38

    y += pillar_h + 60

    # ====== BOTTOM HERO BANNER ======
    bh = 200
    rrect(draw, (M, y, W - M, y + bh), 22, fill=WHO_BLUE)

    draw.text((M + 55, y + 28), "194 WHO Member States Coordinated", fill=WHITE, font=font(76, True))
    draw.text((M + 55, y + 120), "~1.9 billion COVAX doses delivered to 146 countries by mid-2023", fill=WHO_BLUE_MED, font=font(42))

    # Accent circle
    cx, cy = W - M - 180, y + bh // 2
    draw.ellipse([cx - 72, cy - 72, cx + 72, cy + 72], fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
    gf1, gf2 = font(28, True), font(24, True)
    t1, t2 = "GLOBAL", "RESPONSE"
    draw.text((cx - text_w(draw, t1, gf1) // 2, cy - 24), t1, fill=WHITE, font=gf1)
    draw.text((cx - text_w(draw, t2, gf2) // 2, cy + 10), t2, fill=WHITE, font=gf2)

    y += bh

    # ====== FOOTER ======
    footer_y = H - 200
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, H], fill=WHO_BLUE_DARK)
    draw.rectangle([0, footer_y, W, footer_y + 8], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    ff = font(36)
    ft = "This process flow represents a coordinated global health architecture designed to save lives and build resilience against future pandemics."
    fy = footer_y + 38
    for line in wrap(ft, ff, CW - 300, draw):
        draw.text((M, fy), line, fill=(200, 220, 240), font=ff)
        fy += 50

    draw.text((M, H - 68), "Source: World Health Organization (WHO) | COVID-19 Strategic Preparedness and Response Plan", fill=(140, 170, 200), font=font(30))

    wr = "WHO COVID-19 Response"
    wrf = font(34, True)
    draw.text((W - M - text_w(draw, wr, wrf), footer_y + 60), wr, fill=WHITE, font=wrf)

    img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Done: {W}x{H}px, content_end={y}, footer={footer_y}, gap={footer_y - y}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
